title: Bloom Level Ladder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Bloom's Taxonomy
Bloom Verbs
Interaction Patterns
Learning Objectives
description: A p5.js ladder of the six Bloom's 2001 levels with hover definitions, a DOM panel listing each level's eight canonical verbs, an example course outcome and a suitable interaction pattern, a compare mode that highlights shared verbs, and a random-verb quiz with a score counter.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers and learning-technology developers

educational.topic: The six levels of Bloom's 2001 Taxonomy
learningObjectives: Summarize what each of the six Bloom levels asks of a learner.
Name one kind of MicroSim interaction that suits each level.

controls.label: Ladder rungs (hover for definition, click for details)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Concrete data visibility with self-check quiz
keyQuestions: What does each level ask the learner to do?
Why do compare and contrast appear at two levels?
commonMisconceptions: The level named Understand is a good objective verb.
Every verb belongs to exactly one level.
Higher levels are always better objectives.
assessmentOpportunities: One-sentence summaries of each level with a matching interaction pattern.
